summary_en: Correction to prior notice: addition of clarification that treasury shares held for share-based compensation schemes will be retained; shares in excess will be cancelled in principle. No change to acquisition authorization or cancellation schedule.
title_en: Correction to notice regarding determination of matters related to acquisition of treasury shares and cancellation of treasury shares (addition of wording)
translation_en_brief: Insource Co., Ltd. issued a correction (文言追加: wording addition) to its 21 July 2026 announcement regarding treasury share acquisition and cancellation. The original notice disclosed a program to acquire and cancel treasury shares to optimize capital structure and expand shareholder returns. This correction adds clarification to the rationale section: treasury shares held for allocation to share-based compensation schemes will be retained; shares in excess of that amount will be cancelled in principle. No modification to the acquisition authorization limits, price ceiling, execution timeline, or cancellation schedule. This is a procedural amendment to the disclosure, not a revision to the program terms.
